# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secret (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secret" "example_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secret" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  credential_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
  secret_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `credential_id` (String) ID of the parent credential

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `secret_id` (String) ID of the secret to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC 3339 expiration time. Omit for no expiration.
- `id` (String) ID of the secret to retrieve
